title: 太空服生命维持系统异常
description: 太空服或EVA服在资源充足时无法维持生命，导致角色死亡。
evidence: the space suit helmet seemingly not sealing and leading to dying with full battery, O2, and filters
my eva suit that had full battery and oxygen and condition just stops working
